name: Grey Matter Coffee Werks — Design System

tokens.name: gm-cream
tokens.usage: Page and card ground, the default surface. Text on it: gm-charcoal (17.1:1), gm-charcoal-2 (12.4:1), gm-grey (8.3:1).

tokens.name: gm-cream-2
tokens.usage: Sunk surface, hover fill, flat Card ground. Text on it: gm-charcoal (15.3:1), gm-grey (7.5:1).

tokens.name: gm-cream-3
tokens.usage: Hairline and divider on cream (decorative, 1.26:1 — never the only cue); light type on gm-charcoal grounds (13.6:1).

tokens.name: gm-paper
tokens.usage: Packaging ground: the cream inside bean blocks on print.

tokens.name: gm-black
tokens.usage: True black block (mana saja register), inverted surface, and the title and citation type on certificates.

tokens.name: gm-charcoal
tokens.usage: Primary ink: type and heavy rules on cream (17.1:1); dark grounds that carry gm-cream type (17.1:1).

tokens.name: gm-charcoal-2
tokens.usage: Logo charcoal (dark half of the bean mark); body copy on cream and cream-2 (12.4:1 / 11.1:1).

tokens.name: gm-grey
tokens.usage: Logo mid-grey (wordmark ink, light half of the bean mark); secondary copy on cream (8.3:1).

tokens.name: gm-grey-2
tokens.usage: Muted labels and captions on gm-cream (4.47:1, just under 4.5 — keep to 13px+ semibold captions; kept exact from the source).

tokens.name: gm-grey-3
tokens.usage: Disabled and faint meta only (2.4:1 on cream) — never for text that must be read.

tokens.name: gm-teal
tokens.usage: The Grey Matter colour: the leaf in the refreshed logo. Brand-only (logo, About, judge and competition). Fills: gm-charcoal type on it is 5.0:1; gm-cream type is 3.4:1, so only at 24px+ or bold 19px+ (Button teal, Badge teal).

tokens.name: gm-teal-deep
tokens.usage: Teal for text and edges on cream (5.7:1); as a fill it carries gm-cream type (5.7:1).

tokens.name: gm-teal-tint
tokens.usage: Faint teal wash; gm-teal-deep type on it is 4.8:1.

tokens.name: cert-ground
tokens.usage: Ground for certificates of appreciation; every certificate text colour below is checked against it.

tokens.name: cert-teal
tokens.usage: Certificate teal: recipient name at 24px+ (3.9:1 on cert-ground), the rule under the name and the signatory name, and the teal triangles of the border.

tokens.name: cert-red
tokens.usage: Red triangles of the certificate border (5.8:1 on cert-ground). Not a bean colour and not kiasu.

tokens.name: cert-grey
tokens.usage: Grey triangles of the certificate border only (2.8:1 on cert-ground) — never for text.

tokens.name: cert-charcoal
tokens.usage: Dark triangle corners of the certificate border; cert-ground reads on it at 10.3:1.

tokens.name: cert-navy
tokens.usage: Certificate supporting type ('of appreciation', 'presented to') and the small outlined triangles, on cert-ground (13.7:1).

tokens.name: bean-mana-saja
tokens.usage: mana-saja primary (quasi-specialty arabica, black): label strip and headline block. Type on it: bean-on (gm-cream), 18.1:1.

tokens.name: bean-iiwii
tokens.usage: iiwii primary (house blend, yellow): label strip and headline block. Type on it: bean-on-ink, 13.9:1.

tokens.name: bean-ttku
tokens.usage: ttku primary (single origin brazil, green): label strip and headline block. Type on it: bean-on (gm-cream), 6.1:1.

tokens.name: bean-rbtl
tokens.usage: rbtl primary (single origin latin america, burgundy): label strip and headline block. Type on it: bean-on (gm-cream), 7.4:1.

tokens.name: bean-kiasu
tokens.usage: kiasu primary (single origin asia, red): label strip and headline block. Type on it: bean-on (gm-cream), 3.9:1. Below 4.5:1 and kept exact from the packaging: set the bean name at 24px+ or bold 19px+.

tokens.name: bean-iykyk
tokens.usage: iykyk primary (single origin colombia, blue): label strip and headline block. Type on it: bean-on-ink, 8.2:1.

tokens.name: bean-aura
tokens.usage: aura primary (premium single origin/blends, orange): label strip and headline block. Type on it: bean-on-ink, 7.8:1.

tokens.name: bean-xixu
tokens.usage: xixu primary (single origin africa, purple): label strip and headline block. Type on it: bean-on (gm-cream), 6.1:1.

tokens.name: bean-decaf
tokens.usage: decaf primary (decaffinated coffee beans, grey): label strip and headline block. Type on it: bean-on-ink, 13.1:1.

tokens.name: bean-fomo
tokens.usage: fomo primary (limited edition runs, green): label strip and headline block. Type on it: bean-on-ink, 7.6:1.

tokens.name: bean-mana-saja-2
tokens.usage: mana-saja secondary (mid grey): counter-block, tag or second colour in a two-colour run; always beside mana-saja. Type on it: gm-cream, 8.3:1.

tokens.name: bean-iiwii-2
tokens.usage: iiwii secondary (indigo): counter-block, tag or second colour in a two-colour run; always beside iiwii. Type on it: gm-cream, 6.8:1.

tokens.name: bean-ttku-2
tokens.usage: ttku secondary (pink): counter-block, tag or second colour in a two-colour run; always beside ttku. Type on it: bean-on-ink, 5.5:1.

tokens.name: bean-rbtl-2
tokens.usage: rbtl secondary (turquoise): counter-block, tag or second colour in a two-colour run; always beside rbtl. Type on it: bean-on-ink, 10.3:1.

tokens.name: bean-kiasu-2
tokens.usage: kiasu secondary (deep teal): counter-block, tag or second colour in a two-colour run; always beside kiasu. Type on it: gm-cream, 8.1:1.

tokens.name: bean-iykyk-2
tokens.usage: iykyk secondary (sienna): counter-block, tag or second colour in a two-colour run; always beside iykyk. Type on it: gm-cream, 4.1:1. Below 4.5:1 for small type: use it for blocks and large type.

tokens.name: bean-aura-2
tokens.usage: aura secondary (steel blue): counter-block, tag or second colour in a two-colour run; always beside aura. Type on it: gm-cream, 6.1:1.

tokens.name: bean-xixu-2
tokens.usage: xixu secondary (leaf): counter-block, tag or second colour in a two-colour run; always beside xixu. Type on it: bean-on-ink, 8.5:1.

tokens.name: bean-decaf-2
tokens.usage: decaf secondary (tan): counter-block, tag or second colour in a two-colour run; always beside decaf. Type on it: bean-on-ink, 8.2:1.

tokens.name: bean-fomo-2
tokens.usage: fomo secondary (plum): counter-block, tag or second colour in a two-colour run; always beside fomo. Type on it: gm-cream, 6.0:1.

tokens.name: bean-on
tokens.usage: Cream type on dark bean primaries: mana saja, ttku, rbtl, kiasu, xixu.

tokens.name: bean-on-ink
tokens.usage: Ink type on light bean primaries: iiwii, iykyk, aura, decaf, fomo.

tokens.name: bean-iiwii-on
tokens.usage: Type colour on bean-iiwii (alias of bean-on-ink); read BEANS['iiwii'].on.

tokens.name: bean-iykyk-on
tokens.usage: Type colour on bean-iykyk (alias of bean-on-ink); read BEANS['iykyk'].on.

tokens.name: bean-aura-on
tokens.usage: Type colour on bean-aura (alias of bean-on-ink); read BEANS['aura'].on.

tokens.name: bean-decaf-on
tokens.usage: Type colour on bean-decaf (alias of bean-on-ink); read BEANS['decaf'].on.

tokens.name: bean-fomo-on
tokens.usage: Type colour on bean-fomo (alias of bean-on-ink); read BEANS['fomo'].on.

tokens.name: bean-mana-saja-bw
tokens.usage: Greyscale value of mana-saja for B&W production (mono prop on BeanTag and BeanBlock).

tokens.name: bean-iiwii-bw
tokens.usage: Greyscale value of iiwii for B&W production (mono prop on BeanTag and BeanBlock). Near-identical to decaf: the type label must carry identity.

tokens.name: bean-ttku-bw
tokens.usage: Greyscale value of ttku for B&W production (mono prop on BeanTag and BeanBlock). Near-identical to kiasu: the type label must carry identity.

tokens.name: bean-rbtl-bw
tokens.usage: Greyscale value of rbtl for B&W production (mono prop on BeanTag and BeanBlock).

tokens.name: bean-kiasu-bw
tokens.usage: Greyscale value of kiasu for B&W production (mono prop on BeanTag and BeanBlock). Near-identical to ttku: the type label must carry identity.

tokens.name: bean-iykyk-bw
tokens.usage: Greyscale value of iykyk for B&W production (mono prop on BeanTag and BeanBlock).

tokens.name: bean-aura-bw
tokens.usage: Greyscale value of aura for B&W production (mono prop on BeanTag and BeanBlock). Near-identical to fomo: the type label must carry identity.

tokens.name: bean-xixu-bw
tokens.usage: Greyscale value of xixu for B&W production (mono prop on BeanTag and BeanBlock).

tokens.name: bean-decaf-bw
tokens.usage: Greyscale value of decaf for B&W production (mono prop on BeanTag and BeanBlock). Near-identical to iiwii: the type label must carry identity.

tokens.name: bean-fomo-bw
tokens.usage: Greyscale value of fomo for B&W production (mono prop on BeanTag and BeanBlock). Near-identical to aura: the type label must carry identity.

tokens.name: text-strong
tokens.usage: Headings and primary text on surface-page.

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: Hero words on tiles and posters, lowercase editorial or all-caps; one casing per piece.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Roasted on-demand for maximum flavour and freshness.

styles.name: descriptor
styles.usage: Origin and tasting-note line beneath a bean name.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Labels and form eyebrows; add letter-spacing gm-track-label and uppercase.

tokens.name: gm-space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks, icon and label gaps.

tokens.name: gm-shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Floating surfaces such as the cart drawer.

tokens.name: gm-track-label
tokens.usage: Eyebrows, badges and small caps labels.
